current_content_summary: Defines dinter i j = duniform (range i (j+1)) -- the CLOSED-interval uniform distribution on integers (this is what the `[a..b]` distribution notation elsewhere in EasyCrypt scripts resolves to). Core lemmas: dinter1E, dinterE, weight_dinter, supp_dinter(1E), dinter_ll/uni, finite_dinter, perm_eq_dinter(_pred). duni_range_dvd relates dmap-ing a `dinter 0 (p-1)` by mod q down to `dinter 0 (q-1)` when q divides p (a divisibility/rejection-sampling lemma).
